accounting.cpu: Executed editor Z80 instructions/T-states; fake BDOS execution costs excluded.
accounting.instructionUnit: One runtime.step; repeated block instructions may be one step with full repeated T-states.
accounting.textReadBytes: All CPU memory-read callbacks inside fixed text arena; repeated reads counted repeatedly.
accounting.textCopyReadBytes: Subset during LDI/LDD/LDIR/LDDR; includes text-to-text shifts and text-to-DMA copies.
accounting.textScalarReadBytes: Other text-arena reads; scan/read activity, not unique bytes or high-level scan invocations.
accounting.storage: Successful128-byte fake BDOS records plus calls; no physical latency/durability implied.
accounting.setup: Entry/load/render and fixture cursor/layout are excluded from command boundary and separately recorded.
accounting.boundary: First EditorMainLoop before input through EditorMainLoop after final command/render; no uncounted redraw inside boundary.
accounting.hostLatency: Not measured; no inferred keystroke wall latency.
